components.name: Fixed daily signals
components.finding: 253-session warmup, fixed trend/reentry/50-50 mix/cash; causal completed bars.

components.name: Entry and risk controls
components.finding: Cost-aware lot floor, one slot/opportunity, daily pause and synthetic mode rejection.

components.name: Fill and financing ledger
components.finding: Side-specific fills, fees, rollovers, gaps and reconciled cash/equity; no broker fills.

components.name: Quote-to-bar pipeline
components.finding: Causal aggregation and lineages from the same invented execution quotes.

components.name: Chronological accounts and restart
components.finding: Fresh per-period capital, strict observed endpoints, checked restart, monthly/quarterly windows.

market_requirements.name: Source and use scope
market_requirements.finding: Applicable feed-use evidence was not established in the bounded review. This is not a finding of illegality; no contact is requested.

market_requirements.name: Source UTC and receipt age
market_requirements.finding: Observed pilot retains roughly three-hour raw clock difference; no offset or certified quote age.

market_requirements.name: Feed delivery and executable quotes
market_requirements.finding: 7188 latest-quote snapshots over one hour, 61.29% adjacent repeats; not complete ticks or executable-cost proof.

market_requirements.name: Venue calendar and coverage
market_requirements.finding: Weekday calendar and sparse four-quote rule are invented conventions, not certified broker sessions.

market_requirements.name: Contract, commission and slippage
market_requirements.finding: 100000 units, 30:1 leverage and base/adverse cost profiles are retained hypothetical assumptions.

market_requirements.name: Financing and rollover calendar
market_requirements.finding: Side debits and Wednesday triple UTC rollover reconcile in software; actual terms are not qualified.

market_requirements.name: Chronological duration and trade sample
market_requirements.finding: Short invented windows do not meet 24 months per partition, 50 active closed trades and 24 monthly marks.

market_requirements.name: Actually untouched validation
market_requirements.finding: 2024 reused development; 2025 consumed/excluded; October2026 quarantined; reserved November-December2026 untouched and not accessed, too short for 24 months.

market_requirements.name: Actual account execution guards
market_requirements.finding: This package has no broker connection or order API. Before any future demo order component, check actual DEMO type and recheck before submission; real and contest must reject.
